headlineOfDay: Iran's second drone attack on a US base in Bahrain in three days deepens Gulf tensions, as Nvidia turmoil and the Anthropic IPO dominate a nervous week for markets.

markets.summary: Wall Street ended mostly lower, with the Nasdaq down 0.9% and the S&P 500 down 0.4% as chip and tech stocks were sold ahead of Nvidia's earnings and the Anthropic IPO. The Dow edged up and the FTSE 100 rose 0.4%, helped by Centrica and Aviva. Oil edged higher, while gold, silver and copper fell and the US 10-year yield rose to 5.15%.

commodities.label: Brent crude
commodities.note: Oil edged up on the day, though reports of a returning global supply glut have pushed it down over the month while attacks on tankers near Hormuz continue.
